memories.title: Architecture: choose FastAPI for backend
memories.rationale:
FastAPI was selected because the project needs:

- typed request and response models
- asynchronous API endpoints
- automatic OpenAPI documentation
- strong integration with Pydantic

The typed API contracts are particularly useful because the ingestion,
memory, and Q&A layers exchange structured data.
